mapper.select: SELECT e.EMP_ID, e.EMP_NAME, e.DEPT_ID, d.DEPT_NM, e.USE_YN, e.USER_ROLE, e.AUTH_READ, e.AUTH_APPROVE, e.AUTH_CAMPAIGN, e.LAST_LOGIN_IP, e.LAST_LOGIN_TIME, e.CREATED_AT, e.UPDATED_AT FROM EMPLOYEE e LEFT JOIN TB_DEPT d ON e.DEPT_ID = d.DEPT_ID WHERE e.EMP_ID = #{empId}
mapper.update: UPDATE EMPLOYEE SET LAST_LOGIN_TIME = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, LAST_LOGIN_IP = #{lastLoginIp}, UPDATED_AT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE EMP_ID = #{empId}
